sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 31 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：GOOGL、RDDT、SPY、AAPL、AMZN。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今天的主要事件：

  • Interest rates are the real main character: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield rose to approximately 5.26%, its highest level since 2007; the 10-year yield broke above 4.7%, reaching a new high since January 2025, while TLT is currently at 82.19 (-0.73%), continuing to hug the floor. In Japan, the BOJ kept its policy rate at 1% but hinted at another rate hike this year, while the Ministry of Finance spent approximately 8.45 trillion yen (about $52.8 billion) in a single day to intervene in the foreign exchange market—the largest one-day intervention on record. U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent publicly backed the move by stating that the yen was “clearly undervalued.” Brent crude has gained more than 20% this month, while traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has recovered to 30–35% of prewar levels.
  • An inverted V at the open, followed by another V: SPY opened at 744.69, climbed to 746.30, then plunged to 737.70 before recovering to 742.82 (+0.16%) by 10:53; QQQ fell from 695.67 to 680.21 before rebounding to 686.33 (+0.40%); IWM is currently at 290.55 (-0.68%), clearly lagging, with market breadth the weakest link across the board.
  • AAPL collapses, GOOGL takes over: AAPL is currently at 302.33 (-9.23%), with an intraday low of 300.33, as weakness in China and services compounded Cook’s description of memory price increases as a “once-in-a-century” event. In contrast, GOOGL is currently at 351.53 (+5.36%), close to its intraday high, fully recovering its post-earnings decline triggered by higher capex guidance ($195–200 billion for 2026) and free cash flow turning negative. AMZN is currently at 271.48 (+15.16%), holding its massive gap-up, while MSFT is at 453.62 (+0.46%; intraday high of 462.86).
  • The earnings meat grinder: RDDT is currently at 140.22 (-21.29%; low of 136). Revenue reached $805 million, up 61% YoY, EPS was $1.25, and all next-quarter guidance exceeded expectations, yet the stock was slaughtered because Google search referrals were “choppy” and U.S. DAU declined sequentially. RBLX is currently at 34.85 (-28.35%), with revenue of $1.47 billion missing the expected $1.59 billion and full-year guidance lowered; Deutsche Bank and BTIG downgraded the stock outright, setting price targets of $38/$30. COIN is currently at 142.43 (-12.88%) after posting a quarterly net loss of $359 million, while Bitcoin’s drop below 63,000 dragged down MSTR (-6.60%).
  • The one-day memory trade is over: Kioxia’s quarterly operating profit missed expectations and its current-quarter guidance was soft. At the same time, it announced a 1:3 stock split and a share repurchase of up to 800 billion yen, with the Japanese-listed stock closing up 17.7% that day. Its U.S. peers were liquidated from the opening bell—MU plunged from 930 premarket to 828.33 and is currently at 850.52 (-2.78%); SNDK fell from 1404.99 to 1189.02 and is currently at 1242.42 (-2.93%). SOXL remains up 5.40%, indicating that the selloff is in memory, not the entire semiconductor sector.

社区氛围：极度分裂，情绪疲惫——开盘后40分钟内，盘前的“我们回来了”的呼喊变成了“当然这是牛市陷阱”，而随后的V形复苏却让空头咒骂。主流情绪既不看涨也不看跌，而是“每天两次假突破”和越来越阴谋论的心态，让他们彻底疲惫不堪。唯一剩下的共识领域是 GOOGL 多头和 AAPL 空头。

恐惧/贪婪程度：大约 40/100（中性，倾向于恐惧）。一些用户评估自己“只有 15% 感到惊慌”，但我会把这个比例说得更高一些：自杀热线电话号码帖子、“搬回和我父母一起住”以及“温迪正在招聘吗？”本周笑话出现的密度最高。然而，真正的恐慌迹象并没有出现——没有人宣称现金为王，每分钟都会出现新的 RDDT 逢低买入帖子，这表明痛苦而不是投降。

情绪与实际市场表现之间的差异：社区感觉市场正在“崩溃”，而 SPY 实际上为 +0.16%，QQQ +0.40%，道指 +0.16%。一位用户说得非常好：市值最大的公司下跌了 9%，但 SPY 仍然是绿色的，这意味着所谓的集中风险实际上正在发挥作用。真正的痛苦来自于单一股票的分散——同一天，AMZN 上涨 15%，GOOGL 上涨 5.4%，RBLX -28%，RDDT -21%。指数掩盖了这场大屠杀，而 WSB 头寸恰好集中在错误的一半。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及看涨/看跌情绪核心观点总结
